payload.rebuttal: fixed: The probe removed _own_run_for's check for another task still on the prior row, and no test caught it. Added a case to test_a_task_whose_record_holds_run_created_folds_onto_a_run_of_its_own: two tasks sharing one bare row both gain their own run_finished fact before the next fold, so when the fold runs, neither has moved off the shared row when the other's own-row check runs. Without the check they collapse onto one row with one task's status overwriting the other's; with it they split into two rows, each keeping its own status. Verified the new assertions fail against the probe's edit and pass against the real code.
